items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: But Doc Wheeler was there. He happened to have a band there. I don’t know if you’re familiar with Doc Wheeler.

ctx.x: What song was it you were singing?
“Embraceable You.” I’ll never forget it. But Doc Wheeler was there. He happened to have a band there. I don’t know if you’re familiar with Doc Wheeler.
No, I’m not. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
